label: PF Backlog 210
title: Backend: decouple agent cards/loaders from .opencode (framework-agnostic)
body:
## Problem / why
The pipeline is framework-agnostic by design (core/agent_spec.load_specs reads agents/*.agent.json),
but residual coupling remains: agent_card_loader defaults to .opencode/agent, agent_rules lists from
.opencode/agent, pipeline.py prints .opencode paths, and dev scripts read/write .opencode/agent/*.md.
Two parallel card sets exist (agents/*.agent.json canonical + .opencode/agent/*.md legacy).

## Goal
Make the pipeline truly opencode-independent: loaders read agents/ (JSON) or a neutral cards dir;
dev scripts use that dir; .opencode/agent/*.md becomes legacy/archived.

## Acceptance criteria
- No runtime module reads .opencode/agent; grep shows 0 runtime refs.
- agents still load (all 62) and the pipeline runs identically.

## Verification
- grep + a pipeline smoke; wired_audit green.
